description: This file contains unit tests for the Tailscale integration section in a SwiftUI application. It defines a test suite that verifies the UI behavior of the TailscaleIntegrationSection component under various states, such as when the service is not installed, in serve mode, or funnel mode.

classes.name: TailscaleIntegrationSectionTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the Tailscale integration section UI rendering under various conditions.

methods.name: `tailscale section builds body when not installed`
methods.description: Tests the UI rendering when the Tailscale service is not installed.

methods.name: `tailscale section builds body for serve mode`
methods.description: Tests the UI rendering when the Tailscale service is installed and running in serve mode.

methods.name: `tailscale section builds body for funnel mode`
methods.description: Tests the UI rendering when the Tailscale service is installed but not running, in funnel mode.
